ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-24-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an adult and two minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioners, Xiangna Tan & Ruilin Xu, were present in pro per as Guardians ad litem for the minors Ting Fang Tan and Han Bin Tan.
Petitioners were placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Ana Xiangna Tan.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the two minors to Ting Fang Xu and Ben Han Bin Xu.

Decree Changing Names was submitted to and signed by the Court.
